messages:
liz: Heads-up: Tomorrow 07:30 PT we push the NimbusHub marketplace tile + partner SI integration. Need a razor-simple SEV path that covers marketplace, SI, and billing sync issues. Short, machine-readable, and pinned.

henry: +1. Suggest: shared ops channel -> partner support -> Redwood oncall -> partner eng. Also include region fallback (us->eu) and a 48h warm-watch roster.

maya: Can we standardize channel names so tooling can pick them up? Propose: #nh-launch-<env>-ops (e.g. #nh-launch-prod-ops). Pin a one-pager runbook and a single checklist.

carlos: Timeline idea: 0-12m partner/SI triage in channel -> 12-30m Redwood oncall mitigation -> 30-90m partner eng deep-dive -> 90m+ open warroom if unresolved. If billing flags customer_impact=true, page PD immediately.

liz: ops-bot: can you scaffold channel + create two PD policies (marketplace, billing) and wire webhooks? would prefer templates so we don't scramble.

ops-bot: action: /scaffold-channel nh-launch-prod-ops --pins runbook.md,checklist.md --pd marketplace:PD-NH-1,billing:PD-NH-2 --invite @liz,@henry,@maya,@carlos

henry: Runbook minimal contents: contact list (partner eng lead, SI lead, CSM), routing map, escalation timeline, warm-watch rotation, rollback toggle, postmortem trigger (auto-assign if Sev2+).

maya: I'll draft the pinned checklist: incident owner, surface (marketplace/si/billing), region, customers impacted Y/N, immediate mitigations, rollback steps, bridge link, postmortem owner.

carlos: Add a tiny Slack workflow to capture incident metadata on first message and auto-pin it. Something like: /workflow nh-incident-capture -> fields [surface,region,severity,customer_impact,owner] -> post to #nh-launch-prod-ops

liz: Also: auto-create bridge if both marketplace and billing alerts fire or severity==P1. Bridge template: /bridge create nh-launch-warroom --ops @liz,@henry,@maya --duration 3h --auto-status 30m

henry: I'll request PD policies and share ids in the pinned runbook. Also recommend a dry-run tonight to validate webhooks and bridge template.

maya: Will drop the draft runbook into the channel by EOD and run the dry-run.

liz: Perfect. I'll add a one-line ops note to the launch announcement: "Operational path: #nh-launch-prod-ops (warm-watch 48h); see pinned runbook for escalation and paging)" Thanks team :thumbsup:
